name: Jengo Tau
source:
Jengo Tau is an ambassador for the Hammond Duchy, once part of the Shattered Kingdom. Hammond is known as the hub of the slave trade between the Dilan Empire and the Shattered Kingdom's duchies. In Temeria and the Lusanti Kingdom, Jengo uses his diplomatic status to connect to the underground slave trade in those two nations.
